title: Bachche 300 haddiyon ke saath, bade hokar 206 kyun?

captions.instagram:
Paida hue the to lagbhag 300 haddiyan thi, aaj sirf 206! Baaki kahan gayi? 🦴

🦴 Kahin nahi gayi, aapas mein jud gayi! Bachche ke sir ki plates ke beech naram jagah 1-2 saal mein band hoti hai, aur reedh ke neeche ki 5 haddiyan 20-25 saal tak judkar ek ban jaati hain.

Sources: Cleveland Clinic, Britannica, UPMC, LibreTexts.
Photos: Jason Hickey / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0); S. Rowland 1896 / Wellcome Collection (CC0); Sklmsta / Wikimedia Commons (CC0); Ryan Somma / Flickr (CC BY-SA 2.0).

Facts checked:
• A newborn has about 270-300 bones; an adult has 206 — Cleveland Clinic; Britannica; Mental Floss
• The number drops because small bones fuse into bigger ones as we grow — Cleveland Clinic; Britannica
• A baby's skull plates have soft spots between them that close within about 1-2 years — Cleveland Clinic; UPMC
• The sacrum starts as 5 separate vertebrae that fuse into one by the late teens to mid-20s — Britannica; LibreTexts
• The tailbone is 3-5 small vertebrae fused together — LibreTexts; Elsevier
